Name: Wooden Mirror for Fashion Sense
Author: Miru36
Description:
[size=3][b]12 Types of Wooden Mirrors with Different Appearances.
After placement, you can right-click to open the Fashion Sense menu. [/b][/size]

Available from the furniture catalog.
Appearance changes use [b]Alternative Textures[/b].

[size=3][b]Notes on Wall Mirrors[/b][/size]
[u]These are not wall-mounted furniture.[/u]
The reason is that placing them directly on the wall prevents the Fashion Sense menu from being used.
Please place them on the floor first, then use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] to move them onto the wall.
If anyone knows a solution to this, please let me know in the comments or elsewhere.
